integrity: Theorems proved analytically with an exact-rational finite Sturm certificate for shapes 2..14; an auxiliary independent quadrature check was corroborative, not an infinite proof. Embedded verification code uses only Python standard library.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional closed unitary systems; pure complete reset state; equilibrium-renewal Erlang clocks of integer shape. At shapes >=15 only existence of sign reversal, not uniqueness. Generic renewal purity/fidelity formulas precede the threshold; full independent priority review not performed.
title: A sharp fourteen-stage Erlang threshold for stationary quantum purity–fidelity reversal
